title: Cadwaladr's Surprise Spoons
markdown:
Cadwaladr the badger was so happy. It was his first tidy tea party. His garden table sparkled, teacups made a happy clink, and cucumber sandwiches sat in perfect triangles. “Everything must be just right,” Cadwaladr hummed.

Nell the rabbit hopped over. “Oh, Cadwaladr, what a lovely spread,” she said, bringing a thin silver spoon. “It’s for stirring tea gently,” she whispered, “soft as a cloud.”

Betsy the beagle bounded in. “Woof. Tea party,” she barked, holding a round deep spoon. “This is my tasting spoon. Perfect for jam or honey.”

Cadwaladr looked at Nell’s soft spoon and Betsy’s scoopy spoon. They were very different from his own plain spoons. Cadwaladr’s happy hum faded. His tidy garden felt a little surprising.

Then Miss Clover the tortoise ambled in. “Good afternoon,” she said kindly, carrying a large smooth wooden spoon.

Cadwaladr looked at all the spoons: Nell’s feather-spoon, Betsy’s scoop-spoon, and Miss Clover’s warm wood spoon. His tidy table seemed like a place for special surprises. “Oh my,” he whispered, “these spoons are very different.”

Nell hopped closer. “But Cadwaladr, my spoon stirs gently. And Betsy’s spoon is great for tasting your yummy jam tarts.” Betsy sniffed happily.

Miss Clover smiled. “And my spoon is for gathering happy thoughts. We share kind words like gentle breezes.” She waved her spoon, and a feeling of cheerfulness filled the air.

Cadwaladr looked at his friends and their special spoons. Nell’s for gentle stirring, Betsy’s for tasty treats, Miss Clover’s for warm wishes. His table wasn’t surprisingly tricky. It was ready for all the wonderful unique things his friends brought.

“You’re right,” Cadwaladr said, his surprise gone. “My tea party is perfect, just the way it is, with all of us and our special things.” He held up his plain spoon. “And this one is for drinking lovely warm tea.”

So Cadwaladr, Nell, Betsy, and Miss Clover sat down. They stirred with delicate spoons, tasted with happy scoops, and gathered good wishes. A table likes every kind of spoon, if the tea is warm enough. What other tidy party, do you suppose, is waiting for a surprising scoop?
characters: Cadwaladr (tidy tea-party badger), Nell (gentle-stir rabbit), Betsy (jam-tasting beagle)
